integrity.originality_scope: best-knowledge literature comparison, not absolute priority assertion
integrity.proof_method: coordinate hitting sets, partition bijection and direct semantic invariance

scientific_limitations: Fixed finite Boolean vocabulary; only global Boolean combinations of nonempty primitive inclusion atoms with distinct variables and bounded tuple length.
No conclusion for general inclusion atoms or languages with negation, implication, or other team operators.
The census covers the first nonclosed layer, not all closed teams; hidden valuation uniqueness requires arity at least two.
Older unindexed database or combinatorial reconstruction results could establish equivalent conclusions.
title: Sharp arity-local visibility and a Stirling census for primitive inclusion teams
